QF.id: Registration, Code of Conduct and General Obligations_25

question.text: Which merchant bankers are exempt from the minimum revenue generation requirement under SEBI regulations?

answer.text: MBs that only handle equity IPOs on the SME platform
MBs with net worth exceeding Rs. 100 crore
MBs that handle only debt or hybrid instrument issues
All Category II MBs regardless of the type of issues handled

explanation.text: The Logic: NISM-Series-IX (p.81) states that merchant bankers handling only debt or hybrid issues are exempt from the revenue requirements. Page 84 specifies the minimum revenue generation exception in terms of categories such as listed or proposed non-convertible securities, securitized debt instruments, security receipts, municipal debt securities, commercial papers, and listed or proposed REIT/InvIT units. The Trap: The exemption is based on the type of issues handled (debt/hybrid and the listed product categories above), not on the MB category or net worth threshold. Note: Attribute the exemption to the minimum revenue generation requirement using the source's product-category wording, rather than to a specific regulation number unless separately sourced.
